name: Goblins Win!
summary: In Thousand Needles, the goblin race decides who wins a goblin prize box. Goblins Win! names the result for whoever holds the winning ticket.

sections.title: The Goblin Ticket
sections.body: You hold the goblin race ticket while the goblins' side is decided. If they win, the ticket earns you a goblin prize box. The gnome ticket counts for the other side.

faq.q: What is the Goblin Race Ticket?
faq.answer: The Goblin Race Ticket counts for the goblin side of the race in Thousand Needles. If the goblins win, it is the winning ticket.

faq.q: What do you get when the goblins win?
faq.answer: Whoever holds the goblin race ticket when the goblins win receives a goblin prize box.

faq.q: What happens if the gnomes win instead?
faq.answer: If the gnomes win, the gnome ticket counts. That result is called Gnomes Win!, the counterpart to Goblins Win!.
